landingPage.resumeText: Passionate about IT and its security challenges, I work in cybersecurity as a CERT analyst. Creative and persevering, I enjoy taking on team challenges to tackle today's information-security issues.

forensique.title: SOC / CERT
forensique.contentText: Working in a tierless SOC/CERT, handling incidents end to end, from detection to response and remediation alongside the client.

devsecops.title: DFIR
devsecops.contentText: Digital forensics and incident response: scoping, evidence collection and analysis (Dissect, Velociraptor, FTK Imager) to contain and remediate cyberattacks.

pentesting.title: Threat Intel & OSINT
pentesting.contentText: Threat hunting and OSINT: tracking adversary TTPs and practising offensive techniques on platforms such as HTB and RootMe, to better identify and fix vulnerabilities.

developpement.title: Development & Automation
developpement.contentText: Scripting and automation in Python, PowerShell and Bash. Advanced use of Git/GitHub for version control and collaboration on personal and professional projects.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure & Cloud
infrastructure.contentText: Design and operational maintenance (MCO/MCS) of secured infrastructure and cloud environments (AWS, OVH, Scaleway).

aboutMePage.title: WHOAMI
aboutMePage.paragraph_one: A cybersecurity engineering graduate from EFREI Paris, I currently work as a CERT analyst (Incident Response & Cyber Audit) at Dattak, after two years as a SOC/CERT analyst and production engineer at Almond.
aboutMePage.paragraph_two: During my end-of-studies internship I worked on deceptive defense: building detection lures within an information system, while developing my skills as a SOC analyst.
aboutMePage.paragraph_three: I'm passionate about space and the cybersecurity challenges tied to that environment. In my free time I practise OSINT and pentesting. My goal is to help advance cybersecurity in the space domain, where it too often takes a back seat.
